extDescription.message: Summarize the current web page with one click, using your Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

ui_idle_hint.message: Click the extension icon to summarize this page.

ui_truncated.message: This page was long; only the first part was summarized.

error_page_unreadable.message: This page can't be read. Browser pages, the Chrome Web Store and PDFs are not supported.

error_no_content.message: No article text was found on this page.

error_needs_click.message: Click the extension icon to summarize this page. After the tab navigates, the extension needs a new click to read it.

error_host_missing.message: The local component isn't installed or isn't answering. In the extension's folder, run: ./native-host/install.sh

error_claude_missing.message: Claude Code wasn't found. Install it, then run ./native-host/install.sh again.

error_claude_auth.message: Claude Code isn't logged in. Run claude in a terminal and log in.

error_codex_signed_out.message: Codex isn't logged in. Run codex login in a terminal.

error_codex_not_eligible.message: Your ChatGPT plan can't be used for this. Choose another provider.

error_usage_limit.message: You've reached your plan's usage limit. Try again later or choose another provider.

error_provider_failed.message: The provider failed while writing the summary. Try again.

error_codex_missing.message: Codex wasn't found. Install it, then run ./native-host/install.sh again.

options_models_empty.message: The model list can't be empty.

options_help.message: Summaries go through the local component, which runs Claude Code or Codex on this computer with your subscription. Page text is sent only to the provider you choose.
